_note: Step-by-step clues for Letter Matrix (Chapter 28): the book questions and the past-paper questions filed under the chapter, by question id. Each list says what to do with the letters (count steps, or use their places A = 1 … Z = 26), shows the rule on a complete row or column, then sets up the blank. The last clue never gives the answer. tools/check_clues.ts checks them.
